content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Retired/Retiring Principal District Judge or District Judge (retiring not later than 31.12.2026) Experience: Judicial service as Principal District Judge/District Judge with clean service record Age limit: Maximum 65 years Other conditions: Must have clean service record with no adverse remark Must not have been compulsorily retired under Rule 74(b) of Jharkhand Service Code, 2001 or similar provisions Must undertake to serve in the Permanent Lok Adalat of the district allotted upon selection Desirable: Experience or training in mediation and similar fields

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for JHALSA Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Sitting Chairman, PLA need not apply for the said posts

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly fee equals last drawn salary less pension received; conveyance allowance as per the 2025 Amendment Rules. Term of 5 years or till age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JHALSA Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for JHALSA Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format printed in the notice) and send it to Member Secretary, Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority (Nyaya Sadan), Near AG Office, Doranda, Ranchi-834002, by speed post or courier, to reach by 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for JHALSA Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Monthly fee equal to last drawn salary less pension received, plus conveyance allowance.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired/Retiring Principal District Judge or District Judge (retiring not later than 31.12.2026) with clean service record.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have clean service record with no adverse remark. Must not have been compulsorily retired under Rule 74(b) of Jharkhand Service Code, 2001 or similar provisions. Must undertake to serve in the Permanent Lok Adalat of the district allotted upon selection.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Sitting Chairman, PLA need not apply for the said posts.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview before Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority, Ranchi. Candidates may be called for interview before JHALSA, Doranda, Ranchi on date, time and place fixed by JHALSA.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Term of 5 years or till age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier.

faq.answer: Chatra, Dhanbad, Gumla, Jamshedpur, Palamau, Sahibganj, Seraikella.
